title: Christian Rock
style: A polished Mandopop ballad opens with a clean, melodic electric guitar line playing over gentle acoustic guitar strumming. A clear, earnest male vocal enters, delivering an inspirational message with a smooth, heartfelt tone. The arrangement builds into a powerful, uplifting chorus where a full band—comprising steady drums, a solid bassline, and atmospheric synth pads—joins in, supporting layered vocal harmonies that add depth and emotional weight. The song follows a classic verse-chorus structure with a dynamic arc, culminating in a soaring final chorus and resolving with a gentle piano arpeggio and a final, reflective vocal phrase.
lyrics:
[Intro - Electric Guitar Melody]

[Verse 1]
你是否曾躲藏
害怕世界的目光
是否曾被否定
怀疑自己不够坚强
但主的爱不离开
他知道你的名字
他说孩子 你是我奇妙的创造

他的光照亮黑暗之地

[Instrumental Break - Electric Guitar]

因为你属于天父的国度

我属于他
他
